description: This file implements the core authentication service logic, including user registration, login, password validation, and JWT handling within a web application. It contains class definitions, functions for password normalization and token generation, and references external modules such as SQLAlchemy, jwt, and custom project schemas.

classes.name: AuthServiceError
classes.description: Base exception class for authentication-related errors.

classes.name: InvalidCredentialsError
classes.description: Exception raised when user credentials are invalid.

classes.name: TokenValidationError
classes.description: Exception raised when JWT token validation fails.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Encapsulates methods for user registration, authentication, JWT creation and validation, and user retrieval.

methods.name: str normalized_password(password: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a raw password input by stripping whitespace; raises error if input invalid or normalization results in empty string.

methods.name: bool password_within_bcrypt_bounds(password: str)
methods.description: Checks if the password's UTF-8 byte length falls within bcrypt's required bounds (8-72 bytes).

methods.name: User register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with normalized password, enforcing bcrypt bounds, delegating user creation to repository.

methods.name: Tuple[User,str] authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returns user and JWT token if successful.

methods.name: str _create_access_token(self, *, subject: str)
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a given user ID with an expiration derived from settings.

methods.name: TokenPayload decode_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising errors for invalid or expired tokens.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user entity by ID from the database session.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)

ctags.name: get_user_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
